_note: Schema v2. As of Chunk 2d (2026-05-18) the pipelines block is retired and slot resolution flows through config/configurations/. See _schema_notes for the deprecation roadmap.

vision_extraction.description: When image input arrives and the downstream analyst is not vision_capable, route the image through a vision-LANGUAGE model that returns text. The 'slot' field names a slot in the 'slots' block whose preferred + fallback chain is reused; that slot must contain multimodal LLMs (text+image → text), NOT image-generation models. Earlier this pointed at 'image_generates' on the assumption that image-gen models also read images well — they do accept image input for conditioning, but they're tuned to produce images, not JSON descriptions, and asking them to emit structured text hangs the request. The dedicated 'image_extracts' slot exists for this purpose: GPT-5 / Claude Opus 4.7 / Gemini 3 Pro / GPT-4o. The preferred_extractor_bucket / fallback_extractor_bucket fields are the legacy bucket-based fallback used when no slot is configured or when the slot's chain has no vision-input-capable entry. Final fallback to manual-trace UX (WP-4.4) when nothing resolves.

web_supplement.description: DEPRECATED 2026-05-19. Superseded by web_consultation (below) per F-Consult. Disabled by default; section retained so the legacy test_web_supplement.py / test_web_supplement_integration.py suites continue to exercise the old gap-driven sequential flow until they are migrated to the new module. New code should use web_consultation.

web_consultation.description: Step 2 F-Consult web consultation stream. When enabled, the fast model in the step1_cleanup slot identifies search intents from the user prompt (each intent must articulate a one-line justification — anti-nitpicking enforced at the model layer, not via a count cap); all intent queries then fire in parallel via ThreadPoolExecutor with per_query_timeout_seconds bounding each one. Retrieved chunks are tier-classified (approved vs open-web) via tools.web_corroboration.TrustedSourcesRegistry against Reference — Trusted Web Sources, then scored and provenanced for downstream weighting. prompt_sanity.enabled toggles a parallel light factual-sanity check that flags surface-level errors in the user prompt (typos on dates, mis-attributed quotes, named-entity slips); flags are advisory, never blocking. The four consultation streams (vault concept, conversation, relationship, web) run in parallel — there is no token debt across pipeline steps because each step receives a fresh window. See Specification — F-Consult.md for the design.

image_generates._note: General-purpose image generation slot. Serves news photos, illustration filler, and the eventual data-viz illustration fallback. Preferred = openai-gpt-image-1 (artistic richness, moderation-lottery on boundary-pushing prompts); Fallback 1 = Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (catches OpenAI safety_violations refusals); Fallback 2 = local-diffusers (SD 1.5 last-resort if both cloud providers fail). The registry's invoke() walks the chain on prompt_rejected / model_unavailable / quota_exceeded — see capability_registry.fallback_triggering_codes. Editorial cartoons go through a separate slot (`image_generates_cartoon`) so style-locked LoRA fallbacks are only invoked on the cartoon path. DALL-E references removed 2026-05-12 per OpenAI's same-day shutdown announcement.

image_generates_cartoon._note: Editorial-cartoon image generation slot (introduced 2026-05-12), separated from `image_generates` so a style-locked LoRA fallback is only ever reached on the cartoon path. Preferred = a general-purpose image model for artistic richness; Fallback = a publisher-trained style-locked LoRA (e.g., a Civitai LoRA on a Flux base) that enforces project-specific composition constraints by construction. Cascade triggers: registry.invoke() falls through on prompt_rejected (preferred model's moderation refusal), quota_exceeded, or model_unavailable. The cascade does NOT catch a successful-but-spec-violating render from the preferred model — that requires a post-render verifier, which is the calling project's responsibility.

image_extracts._note: Per-pipeline vision-language extraction slot. Read by route_for_image_input when an analyst model is not vision_capable. Each pipeline (interactive / agent) picks one multimodal LLM (text+image -> text); the OTHER pipeline’s pick is used as the automatic backup when the primary is unavailable. Edit via Settings -> Buckets tab -> Image Extracts card (right column). DO NOT put image-GENERATION models here (gpt-image-2, etc.) — those are tuned for text+image -> image output and don’t reliably emit JSON descriptions, which causes the request to hang. All entries must be multimodal LLMs whose output is text and whose input includes image. Validate against catalog by_input_modality.image when adding entries.

_pipelines_retired: Pipelines block removed in install Chunk 2d (2026-05-18). Replaced by config/configurations/<name>.json files. Router auto-derives config_name from context (interactive → user-pipeline; agent/autonomous → background-default) via DEFAULT_CONFIG_FOR_CONTEXT.

_schema_notes.vision_capable_source_of_truth: config/models.json is canonical. routing-config.json::endpoints[].vision_capable is a duplicate kept for backward compatibility; Router.vision_capable_for_endpoint() reads models.json first. Field removal from endpoints[] is scheduled for Chunk 12.
_schema_notes.vision_extraction_legacy_fields: vision_extraction.preferred_extractor_bucket and .fallback_extractor_bucket are LEGACY (slot path supersedes bucket path). boot.py route_for_image_input still consults them as a final fallback; removal scheduled for Chunk 12 alongside the route_for_image_input refactor to slot-only resolution.
_schema_notes.pipelines_block_retired: See _pipelines_retired marker. Removed in install Chunk 2d (2026-05-18). All slot resolution flows through config/configurations/<name>.json via Router auto-derivation from context.
_schema_notes.canonical_identifier_form: TARGET: <provider>:<model_id> for cloud, bare id for local. CURRENT: mixed (some endpoints already use the prefix form, others use bare slugs). Migration to canonical form scheduled for Chunk 12.
